components.name: Tab bar
components.what: The row of 3-5 main sections at the bottom of the screen.
components.when: Use it when the app has a few top-level places people switch between all the time (Home, Search, Profile). In iOS 27, search goes back into the tab row as a tab.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive navigation bar
md.note: A 64 dp bar along the bottom; the active icon sits in a soft pill and fills in. Feels like current Android and Google apps.
md.snippet: homeHomesearchSearchfavoriteActivitypersonProfile

ios.label: Apple tab bar (iOS 27)
ios.note: A floating Liquid Glass capsule above the bottom edge; the chosen tab sits on a soft pill in your brand colour. Search can be one of the tabs, as in iOS 27. For a search tab, give the last tab class c-tab--search: it becomes a round button after the bar (Apple HIG).
ios.snippet: homeHomesearchSearchfavoriteActivitypersonProfile

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Tab bar
fluent.note: White bar with a hairline; the active tab turns your colour with a small top indicator.
fluent.snippet: homeHomesearchSearchfavoriteActivitypersonProfile

carbon.label: Carbon Tab bar
carbon.note: A dark Gray 100 bar, like the Carbon UI shell; a blue line marks the active tab.
carbon.snippet: homeHomesearchSearchfavoriteActivitypersonProfile

ant.label: Ant Design Tab bar
ant.note: A plain white bar; the active tab simply turns your colour.
ant.snippet: homeHomesearchSearchfavoriteActivitypersonProfile

components.name: App bar / navigation bar
components.what: The bar at the top with the screen title, a back button and a couple of actions.
components.when: Use it on almost every screen that is not the very first one, so people know where they are and how to go back.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive top app bar
md.note: Title on the left in a 64 dp bar; it turns a soft tint once you scroll.

ios.label: Apple navigation bar (iOS 27)
ios.note: A see-through bar with a centred title; buttons float in Liquid Glass circles and capsules. Once you scroll, the edge blurs with a fine line (the iOS 27 default).

fluent.label: Fluent 2 App bar / navigation bar
fluent.note: A white bar with a hairline, left-aligned semibold title and square-ish icon buttons.
fluent.snippet: Settings

carbon.label: Carbon App bar / navigation bar
carbon.note: The dark Carbon shell header: Gray 100 background, small product title, 48 px icon buttons.
carbon.snippet: Settings

ant.label: Ant Design App bar / navigation bar
ant.note: A white header with a hairline and a semibold 18 px title.
ant.snippet: Settings

components.name: Segmented control / tabs
components.what: A small switcher between 2-4 views of the same content (For you / Following).
components.when: Use it to filter or switch views inside one screen, not to move between main sections (that is the tab bar).

md.label: Material 3 Expressive tabs
md.note: Text tabs with a sliding underline under the chosen one; full width under the top bar.

ios.label: Apple segmented control (iOS 27)
ios.note: A capsule track with a glass capsule thumb that springs to the chosen option.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Segmented control / tabs
fluent.note: Fluent tab list: text tabs with a short rounded underline under the selected one.

carbon.label: Carbon Segmented control / tabs
carbon.note: Carbon content switcher: joined square buttons; the selected one turns dark.

ant.label: Ant Design Segmented control / tabs
ant.note: Ant Segmented: a light grey track with a white thumb that slides to the choice.

components.name: Toolbar
components.what: A floating bar of actions for what is on screen right now (share, edit, delete a photo).
components.when: Use it on detail or editing screens instead of a tab bar. Put the main action in the middle or at the end.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive floating toolbar
md.note: A 64 dp pill that floats above the content; the main action is a filled, squarish button.

ios.label: Apple toolbar (iOS 27)
ios.note: A floating Liquid Glass capsule with glass buttons; the main action is tinted in your colour.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Toolbar
fluent.note: A white floating bar with 8 px corners and a Fluent shadow.

carbon.label: Carbon Toolbar
carbon.note: A dark Gray 100 bar of 48 px icon buttons.

ant.label: Ant Design Toolbar
ant.note: A white floating bar with 8 px corners and a soft shadow.

components.name: Side menu

components.when: Use it when there are more sections than fit in a tab bar (6+), or for secondary places like Settings and Help.

components.name: Page indicator
components.what: Small dots that show which page you are on in a carousel or a welcome walkthrough.
components.when: Use it under swipeable pages (onboarding, photo galleries) with 2-8 pages.

md.label: Material 3 page indicator
md.note: Dots; the current page stretches into a short pill in your colour.

ios.label: Apple page control (iOS 27)
ios.note: Small dots on a Liquid Glass capsule; the current one is darker and longer.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Page indicator
fluent.note: Small dots; the current one stretches in your colour.

carbon.label: Carbon Page indicator
carbon.note: Small square dots; the current one stretches in your colour.

ant.label: Ant Design Page indicator
ant.note: Ant carousel dots: short bars; the current one is longer.

components.name: Buttons
components.what: The main tappable actions, in four strengths: filled, tonal, outlined and text.
components.when: Use one filled button for the main action on a screen, tonal or outlined for secondary actions, text for the least important.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive buttons
md.note: Round 40 dp buttons that square off their corners while pressed (the Expressive shape morph).
md.snippet: <button class="c-btn c-btn--md c-btn--filled">Follow</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--md c-btn--tonal">Message</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--md c-btn--outlined">Share</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--md c-btn--text">Cancel</button>

ios.label: Apple buttons (iOS 27)
ios.note: Capsule buttons: filled = prominent glass in your colour, tonal/outlined = frosted Liquid Glass with a clear edge; they shrink slightly when pressed.
ios.snippet: <button class="c-btn c-btn--ios c-btn--filled c-btn--block">Follow</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--ios c-btn--tonal c-btn--block">Message</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--ios c-btn--outlined c-btn--block">Share</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--ios c-btn--text c-btn--block">Cancel</button>

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Buttons
fluent.note: 40 px buttons with 4 px corners: primary in your colour, secondary white with a grey edge, outline, subtle.
fluent.snippet: <button class="c-btn c-btn--fluent c-btn--filled">Follow</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--fluent c-btn--tonal">Message</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--fluent c-btn--outlined">Share</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--fluent c-btn--text">Cancel</button>

carbon.label: Carbon Buttons
carbon.note: Square 48 px buttons with the label on the left: primary, secondary (dark grey), tertiary (outline), ghost.
carbon.snippet: <button class="c-btn c-btn--carbon c-btn--filled">Follow</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--carbon c-btn--tonal">Message</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--carbon c-btn--outlined">Share</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--carbon c-btn--text">Cancel</button>

ant.label: Ant Design Buttons
ant.note: 40 px buttons with 8 px corners: primary with a soft shadow, default white, dashed, link.
ant.snippet: <button class="c-btn c-btn--ant c-btn--filled">Follow</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--ant c-btn--tonal">Message</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--ant c-btn--outlined">Share</button> <button class="c-btn c-btn--ant c-btn--text">Cancel</button>

components.name: Floating action button
components.what: A round button that floats above the content for the one main thing people create (new post, compose).
components.when: Use it only when there is one clear "create" action. iPhone apps rarely use it; the Apple version is a simple round tinted button.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive FAB
md.note: A 56 dp rounded-square button with a soft tint and shadow; add a label to make it wide ("extended").

ios.label: Apple-style floating button (iOS 27)
ios.note: A round prominent-glass button in your brand colour (iOS has no official FAB).

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Floating action button
fluent.note: A floating button with 8 px corners and a soft Fluent shadow.

carbon.label: Carbon Floating action button
carbon.note: A square 48 px primary button floating above the content.

ant.label: Ant Design Floating action button
ant.note: Ant FloatButton: a round floating button in your colour.

components.name: Icon buttons
components.what: Round buttons with just an icon (like, share, more), in four strengths; some can toggle on and off.
components.when: Use them for familiar actions where the icon is clear. Always give them a label for screen readers.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive icon buttons
md.note: Standard, filled, tonal and outlined 40 dp buttons; corners square off while pressed. The heart toggles.

ios.label: Apple icon buttons (iOS 27)
ios.note: Glass circles; filled = prominent glass in your colour. The heart toggles.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Icon buttons
fluent.note: 40 px icon buttons with 4 px corners: subtle, primary, secondary, outline.

carbon.label: Carbon Icon buttons
carbon.note: Square icon buttons: ghost, primary, secondary (dark), tertiary (outline).

ant.label: Ant Design Icon buttons
ant.note: 40 px icon buttons with 8 px corners: text, primary, default, outline.

components.name: Chips / filters
components.what: Small rounded options in a row to filter a list or pick tags (Nearby, Open now, Under RM 50).
components.when: Use them above a list or results to narrow it down; they scroll sideways if there are many.

md.label: Material 3 filter chips
md.note: Outlined chips with small corners; a selected filter fills and shows a tick.

ios.label: Apple filter capsules (iOS 27)
ios.note: Soft grey capsules; the selected ones fill with your colour.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Chips / filters
fluent.note: Fluent tags with 4 px corners; selected ones fill with your colour.

carbon.label: Carbon Chips / filters
carbon.note: Carbon tags: small 24 px pills; selected ones turn dark.

ant.label: Ant Design Chips / filters
ant.note: Ant checkable tags: plain text; selected ones fill with your colour.

components.name: Menu
components.what: A short list of actions that pops up from a button (Sort by, More options, Report).
components.when: Use it to tuck away 3-7 secondary actions. Put destructive ones (Delete) last, in red.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive menu
md.note: A tinted card with rounded corners and roomy rows.

ios.label: Apple menu (iOS 27)
ios.note: A Liquid Glass context menu with large corners; icons sit on the left, as in iOS 26 and later.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Menu
fluent.note: A white menu with 8 px corners and a Fluent shadow.

carbon.label: Carbon Menu
carbon.note: A square white menu with a light shadow.

ant.label: Ant Design Menu
ant.note: Ant Dropdown: 8 px corners and Ant's soft layered shadow.

components.name: Action choices
components.what: A set of actions offered at once: Apple uses an action sheet from the bottom, Material 3 Expressive a menu that springs out of the floating button.
components.when: Use it when someone needs to pick one of several actions (Take photo / Choose from library / Cancel).

md.label: Material 3 Expressive FAB menu
md.note: The floating button turns into a close button and opens labelled actions above it.

ios.label: Apple action sheet (iOS 27)
ios.note: Glass groups of actions from the bottom with a separate Cancel; destructive actions in red.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Action choices
fluent.note: A white action list with 8 px corners and a separate Cancel.
fluent.snippet: Profile photo

carbon.label: Carbon Action choices
carbon.note: A square action list with a separate Cancel.
carbon.snippet: Profile photo

ant.label: Ant Design Action choices
ant.note: A white action list with 8 px corners and a separate Cancel.
ant.snippet: Profile photo

components.name: Button group
components.what: 2-5 joined buttons where you pick one (Day / Week / Month) or a set of related actions.
components.when: Use it for a small, always-visible choice inside a screen. For switching whole views, the segmented control also works.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive connected buttons
md.note: Joined buttons with small inner corners; the chosen one turns fully round and filled.

ios.label: Apple button group (iOS 27)
ios.note: Capsule buttons inside one glass capsule; the chosen one fills with your colour.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Button group
fluent.note: Joined buttons with 4 px outer corners; the chosen one fills.

carbon.label: Carbon Button group
carbon.note: Joined square buttons; the chosen one turns dark.

ant.label: Ant Design Button group
ant.note: Ant Radio.Button group: joined with 8 px outer corners; the chosen one fills.

components.name: Text field
components.what: A box for typing, with its label and an optional help or error line.
components.when: Use it in forms: sign in, profile editing, checkout. Error lines tell people exactly what to fix.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive outlined field
md.note: The label sits inside the box and floats up into the border when you type.

ios.label: Apple field (iOS 27)
ios.note: A small label above a soft filled field with rounder 14 pt corners; it outlines in your colour while typing.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Text field
fluent.note: Semibold label above a 40 px field whose bottom edge turns your colour while typing.

carbon.label: Carbon Text field
carbon.note: Small grey label above a 48 px grey field with a bottom border; a 2 px outline shows focus.

ant.label: Ant Design Text field
ant.note: Label above a 40 px field with an 8 px border that glows softly in your colour on focus.

components.name: Search bar
components.what: A search field with a magnifier icon.
components.when: Use it at the top of lists or on a Search tab so people can find things quickly.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive search bar
md.note: A tall rounded pill on a tinted surface.

ios.label: Apple search field (iOS 27)
ios.note: A Liquid Glass capsule field. In iOS 27 apps, search usually lives as a tab in the tab bar.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Search bar
fluent.note: Fluent SearchBox: 4 px corners, darker bottom edge that turns your colour on focus.

carbon.label: Carbon Search bar
carbon.note: Carbon search: a 48 px grey field with a bottom border, square corners.

ant.label: Ant Design Search bar
ant.note: Ant search input: white field with 8 px corners and a soft focus glow.

components.name: Switch
components.what: An on/off toggle for a setting that takes effect right away.
components.when: Use it for settings (notifications on/off). Use a checkbox instead when people confirm several choices with a Save button.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive switch
md.note: An outlined track; the thumb grows and slides when it turns on.

ios.label: Apple switch (iOS 27)
ios.note: The wider Liquid Glass-era toggle with a pill-shaped thumb that stretches while pressed; the track fills with your brand colour.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Switch
fluent.note: Fluent toggle: an outlined 40 x 20 track whose knob fills and slides when on.

carbon.label: Carbon Switch
carbon.note: Carbon toggle: a 48 x 24 track that turns green (support-success) when on.

ant.label: Ant Design Switch
ant.note: Ant Switch: a 44 x 22 pill that fills with your colour when on.

components.name: Checkbox and radio
components.what: Tick boxes for picking several options, round radios for picking exactly one.
components.when: Use checkboxes for "choose any", radios for "choose one" (for example a delivery speed).

md.label: Material 3 Expressive checkbox and radio
md.note: Square tick box and ring radio button.

ios.label: Apple selection (iOS 27)
ios.note: Round ticks for picking several items; a trailing checkmark marks the one chosen option.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Checkbox and radio
fluent.note: Small rounded squares and circles that fill with your colour.

carbon.label: Carbon Checkbox and radio
carbon.note: Carbon checkboxes fill dark (not blue), with square-ish 2 px corners; radios show a dark dot.

ant.label: Ant Design Checkbox and radio
ant.note: Ant checkboxes with 4 px corners that fill with your colour; ring radios.

components.name: Slider
components.what: Drag to pick a value in a range (volume, brightness, price).
components.when: Use it when the exact number matters less than the feel; show the value next to it if it does matter.

carbon.label: Carbon Slider

carbon.snippet: <input class="c-slider c-slider--carbon" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" aria-label="Volume">

components.name: Snackbar / toast
components.what: A short message that pops up after an action ("Saved", "Post deleted - Undo") and disappears by itself.
components.when: Use it to confirm something just happened, with an optional Undo. Do not use it for errors people must act on.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive snackbar
md.note: Dark bar near the bottom with an optional action like Undo.
md.snippet: <body data-c-toast="md"> … <button class="c-btn c-btn--md c-btn--tonal" onclick="C.toast('Post deleted', { action: 'Undo' })">Delete</button>

ios.label: Apple-style toast (iOS 27)
ios.note: A Liquid Glass capsule that drops in at the top, like an iPhone system banner.
ios.snippet: <body data-c-toast="ios"> … <button class="c-btn c-btn--ios c-btn--tonal" onclick="C.toast('Saved to Photos')">Save</button>

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Snackbar / toast
fluent.note: Fluent toast: a white card with 4 px corners and a soft shadow near the bottom.
fluent.snippet: <body data-c-toast="fluent"> … <button class="c-btn c-btn--fluent c-btn--tonal" onclick="C.toast('Post deleted', { action: 'Undo' })">Delete</button>

carbon.label: Carbon Snackbar / toast
carbon.note: Carbon toast: dark Gray 80 with a blue stripe on the left, square corners.
carbon.snippet: <body data-c-toast="carbon"> … <button class="c-btn c-btn--carbon c-btn--tonal" onclick="C.toast('Post deleted', { action: 'Undo' })">Delete</button>

ant.label: Ant Design Snackbar / toast
ant.note: Ant message: a small white card that drops in at the top with a green tick.
ant.snippet: <body data-c-toast="ant"> … <button class="c-btn c-btn--ant c-btn--tonal" onclick="C.toast('Post deleted', { action: 'Undo' })">Delete</button>

components.name: Progress and spinner
components.what: Shows that something is loading or how far along it is.
components.when: Use the bar when you know how far along it is (uploading 60%), the spinner when you do not.

md.label: Material 3 Expressive progress
md.note: A wavy progress line and the shape-morphing loading indicator (Expressive replaces the plain spinner for short waits).

ios.label: Apple progress
ios.note: Thin rounded bar and the eight-spoke iPhone activity indicator.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Progress and spinner
fluent.note: A 4 px bar and a round spinner in your colour.

carbon.label: Carbon Progress and spinner
carbon.note: An 8 px square bar and the bold Carbon loading ring.

ant.label: Ant Design Progress and spinner
ant.note: Ant Progress: an 8 px rounded bar, and a slim spinner.

components.name: Skeleton loading
components.what: Grey placeholder shapes shown where content will appear while it loads.
components.when: Use it instead of a spinner for feeds and lists, so the screen feels faster and does not jump when content arrives.

md.label: Material shimmer
md.note: A soft light sweeps across the placeholders.

ios.label: Apple pulse
ios.note: Placeholders gently pulse, like iOS redacted content.

fluent.label: Fluent 2 Skeleton loading
fluent.note: Rounded grey placeholders with a soft shimmer.

carbon.label: Carbon Skeleton loading
carbon.note: Square grey placeholders with a shimmer.

ant.label: Ant Design Skeleton loading
ant.note: Ant Skeleton: rounded grey bars with a moving gradient.
